generation.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the central angle that subtends the same chord. Here A and B stay fixed, so the central angle remains 120° and the inscribed angle at P remains 60° as you drag P along the opposite arc. The drag is limited to that arc because moving P across chord AB would produce a different angle.
